views.name: public_techniques
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    persona_id,
    category,
    title,
        CASE
            WHEN ((access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN essence
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS essence,
        CASE
            WHEN ((access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN explanation
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS explanation,
        CASE
            WHEN ((access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN memo
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS memo,
    importance,
        CASE
            WHEN ((access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN practices
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END AS practices,
        CASE
            WHEN ((access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN examples
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END AS examples,
        CASE
            WHEN ((access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN cautions
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END AS cautions,
    primary_theory_ids,
    theory_ids,
    status,
    display_order,
    updated_at,
    image_path,
    access_tier,
        CASE
            WHEN ((access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN tags
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS tags
   FROM techniques
  WHERE (status = 'published'::text);

views.name: public_theories
views.definition:
SELECT t.id,
    t.title,
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN t.summary
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS summary,
    t.category_id,
    t.category_title,
    t.aliases,
    t.related_theory_ids,
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN t.provenance
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS provenance,
    t.status,
    t.display_order,
    t.display_id,
    t.image_path,
    t.access_tier,
    t.subcategory_id,
    s.title AS subcategory_title,
    t.taxonomy_order,
    COALESCE(t.canonical_id, t.id) AS canonical_id,
    t.legacy_ids,
    t.knowledge_type,
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN t.quotation
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS quotation,
    NULLIF(btrim((t.quotation ->> 'author'::text)), ''::text) AS quotation_author
   FROM (theories t
     LEFT JOIN theory_subcategories s ON ((s.id = t.subcategory_id)))
  WHERE (t.status = 'published'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT a.id,
    t.title,
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN t.summary
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS summary,
    t.category_id,
    t.category_title,
    t.aliases,
    t.related_theory_ids,
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN t.provenance
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS provenance,
    'published'::text AS status,
    t.display_order,
    t.display_id,
    t.image_path,
    t.access_tier,
    t.subcategory_id,
    s.title AS subcategory_title,
    t.taxonomy_order,
    t.id AS canonical_id,
    t.legacy_ids,
    t.knowledge_type,
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.access_tier = 'free'::text) OR can_read_complete_content()) THEN t.quotation
            ELSE NULL::jsonb
        END AS quotation,
    NULLIF(btrim((t.quotation ->> 'author'::text)), ''::text) AS quotation_author
   FROM ((theories a
     JOIN theories t ON (((t.id = a.canonical_id) AND (t.id <> a.id))))
     LEFT JOIN theory_subcategories s ON ((s.id = t.subcategory_id)))
  WHERE (t.status = 'published'::text);
